name: Fenmark SplitLine Aug-Ready Wide Leg Jean
description: Wide-leg denim in washed black with a unique construction: the outer side seam from knee to hem is sewn with a removable basting stitch over a permanent seam, allowing the outer leg to be opened and reclosed with a hidden snap-stud strip for chrome access or fitting. The denim is a medium-weight stretch blend. They look like fashionable wide-leg jeans; the snap-stud strip is visible only on close inspection.
functionality: Hidden snap-stud strip on outer seam allows lower leg to be opened for chrome access or fitting adjustments and re-closed cleanly.
what_it_says: You care how you look and you've found a way to make augmentation work with that.
worn_by: anyone who wants aug-compatible clothes that don't look like workwear
story_hooks: A character hides a slim object inside the opened outer-seam channel — the snap-stud strip closes over it perfectly.
Someone who doesn't have aug legs is wearing these; the question is whether they're planning to get chrome, or just liked the fit.

physical_description.visual_profile: Fashionable wide-leg silhouette with a relaxed, almost flowing drape from hip to ankle. The cut commands attention without screaming augmentation—it reads as contemporary streetwear at first glance, but the subtle seam detailing along the outer leg hints at intentional engineering.
physical_description.fit: Generous through the hip and thigh, with a pronounced wide leg that tapers slightly at the ankle. Designed to accommodate both unaugmented legs and chrome cyberlimbs of varying circumferences without bunching or binding.
physical_description.primary_material: Medium-weight stretch denim blend—synthetic fibers woven with elastane for give, treated to resist the corrosive salt-spray common in GLMZ urban zones.
physical_description.texture: Soft, broken-in hand with a slightly napped surface. The washed black has subtle fading at stress points (inner thigh, back knee). Close inspection reveals the dual-stitch construction: visible basting thread over a heavier permanent seam on the outer leg.
physical_description.color_scheme: Washed black with natural wear patterns—lighter creasing at flexion points, slight gray undertones from repeated laundering. No pattern; the visual interest comes from construction and texture.
physical_description.closures: Standard fly with button and zipper. The innovation lies in the hidden snap-stud strip running vertically along the outer seam from knee to hem—snaps are recessed and color-matched to denim, nearly invisible unless you're looking for them.
distinctive_features: Removable basting stitch over permanent outer-leg seam—engineered for quick access without compromising structural integrity
Hidden magnetic snap-stud closure strip along the outer seam for chrome limb fitting or medical access
Medium-weight stretch blend allows the outer leg panel to flex open without tearing
Subtle Fenmark logo stamp on interior waistband (corpo-grade branding, not ostentatious)
Reinforced stress points at knee and ankle for durability against constant adjustment cycles
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover. The engineering and materials signal corpo awareness and access to specialty garment tech, but the aesthetic is deliberately understated—not flashy enough for Tier 1 haute couture, too refined for pure street salvage.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmentation-ready professionals, field techs, and anyone managing chrome installation or maintenance. The wearer signals comfort with their own body's potential transformation—neither hiding nor advertising it. Popular among medical workers, corpo field operatives, and serious modders.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn-in but maintained. The basting stitch shows light creasing from repeated opening/closing cycles. The outer seam may have faint marks from snap engagement. Overall impression is 'functional gear that's been broken in,' not pristine.
